info.syllabusName: Digital Marketing Analytics_Phân tích marketing số
info.description:
This Course is based on the Coursera Specialization "Digital Marketing" and Google Digital Marketing & E-commerce Certificat Professionnel, which covers both the dynamics and the global aspects of digital marketing. You'll learn how to attract customers using various digital channels, measure marketing performance through analytics, and manage e-commerce stores to boost customer loyalty.

*Teaching method: This is a blended-learning course, in which students will take a look at the videos & slides and reading on Coursera first at home, then rewatch & discuss key questions with classmates and teachers at classes.

Students will use AI tools and applications to:

- support generating and refining ideas

- assist in content suggestions,

- assist in answering questions on Edunext, in-class discussions, and identifying credible sources.

- supports summarizing and concluding research findings through data-driven insights and structured templates.
info.studentTasks:
- Access the learning materials on Coursera for self-study purposes

- Attend at least 80% of contact hours in order to be eligible for the final assessment

- Actively participate in class activities

- Fulfill tasks given by instructor after class

- Use their own laptop in class only for learning purpose

- Access http://flm.fpt.edu.vn for up-to-date course information

clos.loDetails: Identify the web analytic tool right for your specific needs in basic
Well understand valid and reliable ways to collect, analyze, and visualize data from the web
Utilize data in decision making for agencies, organizations, or clients
Well understand how to measure, manage, and analyze data from marketing campaigns using Google Analytics, Google Ads, and similar tools
Good ability to analyze and visualize data and insights in spreadsheets and prepare presentations to share campaign progress or results with stakeholders.
Shows self-reliance when working independently and collaboratively
Demonstrate ethical awareness and reflection in business context
